# Choosing the paving slabs for the seating corner

The seating corner will use forty grey concrete slabs, each sixty centimetres
square, from the builders' merchant on the high street. They are cheaper than
sandstone and lie flat on a sand bed without extra edging. The order is
collected in two trips so the wheelbarrow is never overloaded, and the slabs
are laid dry first to check the fit before any sand goes down.
